svg.title: The engagement, from the tasks you send to support
svg.desc: Before: you send twenty to thirty of your team's own tasks, de-identified, and name the models it may use. Weeks 1 and 2: the measured assessment, $7,500 fixed and remote; each task runs three times through each model, with the predictions written before the first run. End of week 2: the report, with accuracy by model and family, the silent-wrong-answer map and one recommendation, yours to keep. About two months: the follow-on, kickoff and deploy, integrate, build the curriculum, live training, priced from the report. Ongoing and optional: support from $1,000 a month.
